description: What the teacher returns after a finished lesson. It carries only what requires judgement: the app already knows every measurable fact (which auto-graded answers were right, how long the lesson took, which skills it touched) and does not ask for those back.

graded.description: One entry per exercise the app could not grade locally (translation, freeResponse). Do not include auto-graded exercises.

score.description: 0-10. The app derives SM-2 quality as floor(score / 2).

comment.description: Markdown. Follow the fluent-feedback-formatter shape: celebrate what worked, correct each mistake with category and a brief why, then the full correct version.

errors.description: Distinct mistakes worth tracking, from ANY exercise including auto-graded ones. Collapse duplicates: one entry per pattern.

patternId.description: snake_case, stable across sessions so frequency accumulates. Reuse an existing id from mistakes-db when the mistake is the same one.

newVocabulary.description: Vocabulary worth adding to the learner's dictionary: words met for the first time in this lesson, and — when the lesson opened a new topic — the handful of words that topic needs next. These go into spaced repetition AND into the learner's word list for drilling, so supply the reading and an example: they are what make a word drillable rather than just recorded.

reading.description: Reading in kana, when the entry is written with kanji. Lets the learner be tested on the reading, and furigana shown or withheld.

example.description: One short sentence using the word, with furigana as 漢字[かんじ]. A gloss says what a word means; a sentence shows what it does.

exampleGloss.description: That sentence in the learner's language.

breakthroughs.description: Genuine progress worth naming. Empty is an honest answer.

sessionNotes.description: A few sentences of diagnosis for the tutor's own records: what is consolidating, what is lagging, what the numbers do or do not support.

milestones.description: Only for genuinely notable firsts. Usually empty.

overallComment.description: Markdown shown to the learner as the lesson debrief.
